status: frozen before any Kaggle (7B/8B) responses or labels were inspected
already_seen_before_registration: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct validation responses with refusal_rules labels (laptop run c329cc53cfe58b65) and the exploratory analysis on them (round 2, Agent B)
question: Does spectral boundary proximity of the original response in a per-model response-embedding k-NN graph predict whether the model's refusal decision changes on a related variant prompt, beyond simpler baselines?

data.test_split: not generated and not scored in this pilot
data.generation: greedy, single repetition, template defaults, no shared system message; max_new_tokens 512 on Kaggle, 256 on the laptop

outcome.primary: refusal_flip: refusal label of the original response differs from that of the variant response (one row per model and pair)
outcome.secondary: harmful_transition: original response not harmful and variant response harmful (WildGuard only)
outcome.label_source: WildGuard refusal where available; refusal_rules otherwise. The source is recorded per model. When both exist, the other label is reported as a sensitivity analysis.
outcome.exclusions: pairs with a failed response, a label error or a null label; counts reported

information_rule: Features may use both prompt texts, the original response and its labels, and the response graph built from original responses. Never the variant response or its labels. Neighbor-label features use training-fold originals only.

boundary_candidates.graph: symmetric cosine k-NN over original responses of one model; normalized Laplacian; bottom eigenvectors by scipy eigsh

model: L2 logistic regression (C=1) on standardized features; B1 = B0 + one boundary score

protocol.confirmatory_within_pilot: For models with a development split: choose (k, score) by 5-fold GroupKFold cross-validated PR-AUC within development only; fit B0 and B1 on all development pairs; score validation once.
protocol.exploratory: Validation-only models: 5-fold GroupKFold out-of-fold predictions on validation groups, with (k, score) fixed to the choice made on Mistral/Zephyr development data. Reported as exploratory.
protocol.primary_estimand: Pooled validation ΔPR-AUC = PR-AUC(B1) - PR-AUC(B0) over Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 and Zephyr-7B-beta pairs
protocol.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over prompt groups (2,000 draws); a resampled group keeps all its pairs for every model

interpretation.positive_signal: lower 95% bound of pooled ΔPR-AUC above 0
interpretation.status: Pilot evidence only. The confirmatory test is the 8-model test-split evaluation under decisions.md Section 8 (lower bound > 0 on at least 300 clean test pair groups; positive Δ in at least 6 of 8 checkpoints and 2 of 3 families).

sensitivity_analyses: alternate label source where both exist
template-held-out validation pairs (variant shares no word 8-gram template with training-fold variants)
k in {10, 15, 20} for the chosen score, reported, not selected

layer1.cross_layer: exploratory only: per-checkpoint E_q at q=0.3 against measured refusal drop under adversarial rewrites; at most 11 checkpoints from 3 families, no inferential claim
